provenance.provenance_status: exact (extracted and committed in the same session, unlike hrrr_apcp_1h's reconstructed provenance)
provenance.notes: scripts/pilot_phase3c_hrrr_rh.py existed as an uncommitted working-tree file at the time this backfill ran (first attempt aborted at 8774/20836 on an underestimated byte budget, confirmed benign -- see below; resumed cleanly from checkpoint after raising BYTE_BUDGET from 14e9 to 45e9). The script was committed unchanged after the resumed run completed. From that commit onward, the committed code and this dataset are consistent and reproducible together.

attempts.first_attempt: aborted at 8774/20836 items (42.1%), 1 transient ConnectionResetError, network-safety byte budget (14GB) exceeded early due to an underestimated per-item size assumption (~0.33MB/item assumed vs. ~1.6MB/item actual, a benign sizing miscalculation confirmed via a steady, non-anomalous accumulation rate in the run log -- not a product/semantic defect)
attempts.second_attempt: resumed from checkpoint (only the 12,062 pending items re-attempted, including the 1 prior failure, which succeeded on retry) with BYTE_BUDGET raised to 45e9; completed cleanly, 20836/20836 DONE, 0 FAILED

runtime_overrides.note: BYTE_BUDGET raised from the script's original 14e9 after the first attempt's network-safety abort; see work_items.attempts above

value_range_check.note: physically plausible relative-humidity range, confirmed by direct inspection of the persisted primary-grid-point rows

relationship_to_original_pilot: Purely additive. Does not modify, replace, or depend on writing to data/processed/pilot/hrrr/ (the original 20,836-item, 835-part HRRR pilot), which remains byte-for-byte unchanged. Consumed by data/pilot_loader.py's _load_hrrr_with_rh(), which concatenates this dataset into the in-memory HRRR dataframe so RH is treated as just another native HRRR variable by every downstream function (eligible_mask, atmospheric-trajectory extraction) -- never used to replace DPT or confused with a future engineered RH derived from TMP+DPT.
